title: Source Connection Trust Verify Result 1.0
description: ADR-0087 §2 result: the closed content-free response of a completed or replayed VerifyConnectionTrust command (REST POST /api/v1/sources/connections/{id}:verify-trust and MCP knowvault_verify_connection_trust), identical to what a replay of the same idempotency key returns. Carries no connector identity, attestation text or timestamp; those live only in the canonical document (source-connection-trust-verify.schema.json) and never leave the command boundary in the response.
